full_judgment:
10. Mr. Jamiruddin Sircar, the learned Counsel, appearing for the appellant argues that the High Court Division erred in failing to consider that the judgment of the lower appellate Court was not a proper judgment of reversal and that the finding of fact arrived at by the said Court was not on consideration of evidence. He, submits that the lower appellate Court did not at all consider the documentary evidence adduced by the appellants particularly C.S. Khatian Exts. C and C (1) and dakhilas Ext. B series. The learned Counsel further argues that the lower appellate Court was not correct in holding that there was absolutely no legal evidence about the spliting up of the original holding. 

 16. Reversal of the trial Court's judgment, without adverting to the evidence on which trial Court's judgment is based, is not a proper judgment of reversal and in the facts and circumstances of this case the High Court Division misdirected itself in refusing to interfere with the decision of the lower appellate Court.
